title: Extract 1–3 iso-surface shells (marching cubes) as RT occluder meshes
purpose: Approximate volumetric self-occlusion by extracting thin iso-surfaces from the coarse density grid and using them as RT occluders (BLAS).

steps.detail: CPU or compute-based marching cubes on 1–3 thresholds (e.g., low/med/high density). Output triangle meshes (position only).
Create device-addressable vertex/index buffers and build BLAS for each shell; rebuild/refit when grid updates.
Instance shells into TLAS (1–3 instances). Apply identity transforms; log BLAS triangle counts and TLAS device address.

acceptance: Shell BLAS built with non-zero triangles
TLAS updated; visible occlusion when RT enabled (even before softening)
notes: Choose thresholds to roughly bracket the particle density range; start with a single shell for performance then add more if needed.
